lines: At the same time―――
Once she took down the final monster, the surrounding landscape completely changed.
Asagi
Asagi was in Gosha Academy's underground training room.
It was a training facility with simulations which combined robots with stereoscopic imagery.
She had just been doing her usual training there, on her own.
The enemy level was at max, and she had broken a new end-of-battle points record, but her face looked dissatisfied.
Asagi
「The salamanders are one thing, but Yaguruma Yaemon is set a little too easy.」
Asagi
「Like this, anybody would win. I'll have to make him a little tougher.」
While saying things like that, she was fiddling with the simulator settings on her authority as a teacher, when
Asagi
Suddenly, she felt someone's gaze.
She turned around, but there was no one there.
Asagi
「I wonder if Murasaki's been peeking again?」
While tilting her head in confusion, Asagi finished setting preferences and left the training room behind.
Someone had been hiding and watching her.
Without the “Almighty Taimanin” even noticing.
